coverage_assessment: An initial Portuguese-language web sweep used 11 general, weekly and sector queries returning 280 ordered result headers. It covered labor/CGTP actions, health, education, hotel/restaurant, cultural work, shop reopening, football supporters and selected Lisbon, Porto, Coimbra and Loures leads. Twenty source cards are preserved; only one current article body was read and one prior Portugal-January card was consulted. The Petrogal 2 February candidate remains pending because the scoped body establishes neither a 50-person gathering nor a state-directed demand. Seventeen cards remain search-only; JPN returned an exact-URL 403 and CGTP post-action access had technical retrieval failures. This is not exhaustive: local event detail, turnout, state targeting, ends/responses, other regions/sectors, independent corroboration and LexisNexis remain open. No protest absence is inferred. The official baseline/version and final inclusion review remain pending.
